name: Dark Lords Don't Give A :)
source:
Dark lords are powerful and scary beings... Or maybe not. Young summoner of darkness, your land is being invaded by ghost cats and you need to request help to the ancient protectors of your faction... BUT THEY'RE SO UNRELIABLE! SOMEONE SEND HELP PLEASE???

--------------------------

Your land has been invaded by the ghost cats. As a young summoner of the darkness, you decided to summon the Supreme Dark Lord Goat, the ancient protector of the land. However......what happened? He doesn't remember agreeing to protect your land? What? Summon another dark lord? What? Dark Lords don't give a :)?
translation:
黑暗领主是强大而可怕的存在……也许不是。年轻的黑暗召唤师，你的土地正被鬼猫入侵，你需要向你派系的古代保护者请求帮助……但他们太不可靠了！请有人帮忙？？？

--------------------------

你的土地已被鬼猫入侵。作为一名年轻的黑暗召唤师，你决定召唤至高黑暗领主山羊，这片土地的古老保护者。然而……发生了什么？他不记得答应保护你的土地了？什么？召唤另一个黑暗领主？什么？黑暗领主不给:)？
